paper_source.citation: Azizov, Vela-Tambo, Guo, Transpilation-Aware Runtime Prediction for Noisy Quantum Circuit Simulation, arXiv:2609.12980v1 sections4-5
paper_source.implementation_status: Author code and full dictionaries unavailable to this project.
paper_source.paper_breakdown: 36 Ma-Li-derived fields plus five SupermarQ; hybrid adds13 compiled fields. Counts are paper evidence, not adaptation acceptance dimensions.
paper_source.retained_design: Operation DAG, three TransformerConv layers, mean pooling, separate two-layer global MLP, concatenation/regression head; controlled source/hybrid/transpiled comparison and five classical families.

Explicit13 compiled fields are not asserted to be paper-exact
Declared operation-node encoding omits unknown author node calibration encoding
One FakeSherbrooke/Opt1 local warm cell, rather than two backends/four optimization levels on HPC
Frozen exact-hash five-fold OOF instead of selected80/20 split
Fixed hyperparameters plus train-only epoch selection instead of unavailable author search spaces

local_cell.label_reduction: Existing observed_seconds: median of five timed repetitions/session, then median across three sessions; filter core_q2_q9 without modifying labels.
local_cell.packaging_action: Restore existing environment/lock from the original repository at the same relative paths and verify hashes; no new timing required.

context.version_note: Record distribution and module versions separately; do not replace historical preprocessing by Qiskit2.5.2.

local_cell.frontier_q10_q16: 42 members are scaling/coverage only; no frontier labels or circuits in vocabulary, preprocessing, epoch selection or core accuracy claims.

representation_contract.common_identity: Exact source_sha256; aliases remain separate ledger members but share the same fold.
representation_contract.hybrid_gnn: Identical source graph/+51 globals followed by13 compiled globals in dictionary order.
representation_contract.transpiled_gnn: Replay compiled DAG +51 globals evaluated on the same compiled circuit.
representation_contract.transpilation: Historical stack and snapshot: transpile(qc,backend=FakeSherbrooke(),optimization_level=1,seed_transpiler=1234). Preserve declared idle wires and original physical indices. Never simulate or collect new runtime labels.
representation_contract.compiled_evidence_gate: Compare each row's physical_width,physical_depth,physical_ops,physical_two_qubit_ops,swap_count and operation-DAG node count to C44 using the pinned historical summary extractor. Mismatch is compiled_replay_mismatch. Matching summaries establish reconstruction-qualified replay, not byte-exact submitted/measured compiled QASM recovery.
representation_contract.representation_manifest: Record input/compiled QASM bytes and digests, lossless circuit serialization, environment/extractor/protocol hashes, snapshot/noise hashes, operation counts and unlisted gate audit. Source aliases must yield identical digests.

dag_size_policy.controlled_set: Materialize all variants first; if any fails support/caps/replay, all three are unavailable for that hash in the controlled comparison. Keep all162 in coverage.
dag_size_policy.unsupported: Dynamic/legacy conditional control, symbolic or non-real parameters and empty graphs; no flattening or fabricated nodes.

split_and_fit.outer_split: Use C44 fold unchanged; audit first8 SHA256 bytes of '20260925-split|' +source_sha256 big-endian modulo5.
split_and_fit.training_alias_policy: One outer-train example per hash, target median of existing alias observations inside outer-train. Features agree across aliases. Predict once per held-out hash and expand to held-out member IDs. Every local method uses this same reduction.
split_and_fit.preprocessing: Remove zero-variance global columns on unique training hashes only, then population-mean/std StandardScaler. Persist removed names/statistics. All-constant vectors become one explicit constant0 column. Categorical vocabulary and transforms use inner-train during epoch selection and are refit on full outer-train for final fit.
split_and_fit.inner_validation: Sort outer-train hashes by SHA256('azizov-inner-1234|'+hash); first ceil(0.2*N) validation, remainder inner-train; persist IDs. Select epoch by smallest validation log1p MSE, ties earliest, then refit from scratch on full outer-train for selected epochs.
split_and_fit.target_transform: log1p(seconds), max(0,expm1(output)) in seconds; nonfinite/overflow is failure, not silently clipped.
split_and_fit.seed_reduction: Median of exactly three successful predictions per row; retain all seed predictions/dispersion. Missing seed leaves median unavailable until same-contract resume.
split_and_fit.neural_compute: CUDA mandatory for training and inference. Record CUDA operation smoke test, GPU/driver/framework/CUDA/precision/peak memory before fit.
split_and_fit.timing_isolation: All simulator timing workers stopped before training; CPU baselines may accompany neural training under thread caps. Hold exclusive advisory locks /tmp/qre-benchmark-gpu-lease.lock and work/locks/maestro_qcsim_v2_cpu_timing.lock throughout CUDA smoke/training/inference; every CUDA runner must use the shared lease. Record lock acquisition and live-worker check, keep locks held until child workers are reaped. If occupied, queue rather than run concurrently.
no_selection_rules: no accuracy threshold to continue folds

neural_model.graph_branch: Three TransformerConv layers, hidden178, heads1,concat=true,beta=false,dropout0,root_weight=true; ReLU each,global_mean_pool.
neural_model.head: Concatenate178+64; Linear242->512,ReLU,Linear512->512,ReLU,Linear512->128,ReLU,Linear128->1.
neural_model.reproducibility: Seed Python/NumPy/torch/CUDA; deterministic algorithms, cudnn benchmark=false, fixed DataLoader generator. Unsupported deterministic kernel fails explicitly.
neural_model.oom_policy: Resource_failure under fixed batch policy, retained in coverage; no truncation or silent adaptive batch change.

classical_baselines.package_policy: Pin fitting sklearn/XGBoost versions. Install missing package in isolated fitting environment and record lock before fold0; no estimator substitution.

evaluation.denominators: 162 assigned members/150 hashes separately from successes. Primary evaluation has one target per exact hash: median of existing observed_seconds across its core aliases, with one held-out prediction per hash. Compute all primary metrics on those hash targets. Also report member-level C44-compatible metrics separately; do not mix the two reductions.
evaluation.paired_comparison: Identical successful held-out hashes and target reduction for graph/global-baseline pairs and source/hybrid/transpiled contrasts. With unequal full-envelope coverage, shared-row comparisons are conditional on that intersection and never establish an all-assigned-row winner. Historical member-level results must be reaggregated from saved predictions under the declared hash target before joining this comparison.
evaluation.bootstrap: 10000 paired exact-hash replicates with 95% percentile intervals. Use benchmark_v1/registry/seed_registry.json: SHA256(root_seed|bootstrap_stream|artifact_id|comparison_label|0), first four bytes big-endian, as specified in docs/benchmark_completion.md. Resample hash-level targets/predictions together; record exact seed and quantile implementation. Separate observed difference/bootstrap mean/interval.
evaluation.claim_limit: Instance-group OOF on one backend/optimization is not family/backend holdout or a reproduction of HPC accuracy.

reader_claim: Independent Azizov-style local source/hybrid/transpiled graph+global MLP adaptation with explicit51/64/51 inputs, frozen noisy-Aer warm labels and shared exact-hash folds; no paper-exact or published-accuracy reproduction claim.
